note: This indicator counts anyone who visited one of 19 tracked AI tools during the period, from a single visit to daily use. It does not distinguish between occasional and frequent users.
title: Share of working-age adults who use generative AI vs. GDP per capita
subtitle: Share of the population aged 15–64 who used a [generative AI](#dod:generative-ai) website or app during the reported period. Estimated from anonymized usage data on Microsoft platforms, scaled up to represent each country's working-age population. GDP per capita is adjusted for differences in living costs between countries.
